item.text: {"summary":"An upright, woody perennial native to South Africa, butterfly pelargonium has softly hairy side shoots and heart-shaped leaves. Its pale pink to crimson flowers have two large upper petals marked with a dark violet blotch and three smaller lower petals. It grows along forest edges and in partly shaded places near streams in the southern Western and Eastern Cape.","humanEdibility":"unknown","edibilityNote":null,"evidence":{"summary":["s1:p1","s1:p3","s1:p4","s1:p5"],"humanEdibility":[]}}
